title: Correct U_BA value
description: Essential: The answer must give U_BA = 1200 V (or equivalent with correct sign).

title: Correct potential energy difference
description: Essential: The answer must give ΔU = -6 × 10⁻⁵ J for the charge's energy difference between A and B.

title: Correct potential at A
description: Essential: With M grounded, the answer must give φ_A = -480 V.

title: Correct potential at B
description: Essential: With M grounded, the answer must give φ_B = -1680 V.

title: U_BA formula application
description: Important: Uses the correct formula U = E * d * cosθ for potential difference in a uniform field.

title: Energy from potential difference
description: Important: Correctly relates electric potential energy difference to charge and potential difference (ΔPE = q * ΔV).

title: Potential from grounded plate
description: Important: Correctly calculates potential at a point using the field strength and distance from the grounded plate (φ = -E * d).

title: Sign error in U_BA definition
description: Pitfall: Confuses U_BA with U_AB or misapplies the sign convention for potential difference.

title: Unit or power-of-ten error
description: Pitfall: Fails to convert cm to m correctly or makes an error in the exponent/power of ten in calculations.

title: Consistent sign for energy
description: Optional: Explicitly states the relationship between the sign of the energy difference and the work done by the field.
